body:
The Build page starts a build from the recipes and shows its progress, without a command line.

- Start and cancel a build; one at a time per Solace root.
- Each step shows its status (waiting, running, passed, failed) and a live log.
- A failed step gets a short summary: the step, the command, the first errors.
- **File a task from this failure**: creates a task with the failure summary and log attached, scoped to the failing project, so an agent can fix it.

Depends on: build: recipes in solace.toml.

Done when: the human can build every project from the page and turn a failure into a task in one action.
title: build: run from the Build page
